theme.title: Theme
theme.desc: Choose between default Light mode and eye-friendly Dark mode

fontScale.title: Font Size
fontScale.desc: Adjust the base text size across the entire screen

oneHanded.title: One-Handed Mode
oneHanded.desc: Aligns buttons and cards to one side for easier thumb reach

orderMode.title: Order Screen Layout
orderMode.desc: Browse the entire menu on one screen or select step-by-step with focus

menuLayout.title: Menu Display Style
menuLayout.desc: Choose between visual cards or a high-legibility row list

highContrast.label: High Contrast Mode
highContrast.desc: Increases contrast ratio between text and background to 17:1 or higher

dyslexiaSpacing.label: Dyslexia-friendly Spacing
dyslexiaSpacing.desc: Increases letter, word, and line spacing to improve readability

reducedMotion.label: Reduce Motion
reducedMotion.desc: Completes page transitions and decorative animations immediately

timeoutExtension.label: Double Notification Duration
timeoutExtension.desc: Extends toast notification duration from 3 seconds to 7 seconds

voiceGuide.label: Voice Guide (VoiceOver Preview)
voiceGuide.desc: Reads out ordering steps and menu items via browser speech (Prototype)
voiceGuide.descDetail: Reads out step-by-step order steps and menu items via browser speech
